must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap
must_identify.evidence: The ConfigMap frontend-nginx (mounted into frontend pods at /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf) was edited and introduced a typo in the nginx directive: proxy_conect_timeout 2s;   # should be proxy_connect_timeout

notes: The readiness probe failure is presented as a consequence of nginx not starting, not as the cause, so it does not count as a wrong answer. The rollout explanation is slightly muddled: it says the rollout will 'stall at 1 new/healthy replica', but the new pod is not healthy. The core diagnosis and fix are accurate.
